title: Hiring Illustrators/Sketchers/Cartoonists for Turing AI Character Art Project
content: **WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS!** **TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here!** Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration? **Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project!** Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome! **JOB DETAILS** Company: Turing Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Location: Fully Remote Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task; rate not specified) Project Duration: 10–12 weeks Commitment: 20–40 hours/week Start: After onboarding and portfolio approval **REQUIRED SKILLS** Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop Digital Illustration & Sketching Character Design & Cartooning Composition, Color & Perspective Creativity & Attention to Detail **QUALIFICATIONS** Strong art portfolio showcasing your skills Experience with Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools Ability to maintain character consistency across different styles Familiarity with surreal, cinematic, retro, steampunk, or other visual styles is a plus Able to work independently and meet deadlines **YOUR ROLE** Create high-quality character illustrations from references.
